title: Worcester woman gets jail time for fatally striking pedestrian in 2020
author: Brendan Nordstrom
bullets: Local News The 52-year-old will serve 2 1/2 years for striking and killing Timothy Gain, and then leaving the scene.
A Worcester Superior Court judge sentenced a 52-year-old Worcester woman Tuesday to 2 1/2 years in a correctional center for a 2020 hit-and-run in which she fatally struck 58-year-old Timothy Gain.
Kathryn Quinn, who was driving a dark Cadillac on July 30, 2020, crossed the double lines on Lincoln Street and struck Gain before leaving the scene, Worcester Police say.
